description:
*"To make Master Daeseung mine, I’ll do whatever it takes!"*

Beom Dae-seung, the young master of a noble family, is secretly in an intimate relationship with his close friend Kim Han-seo. Meanwhile, Seo Jae-ryong, who is deeply in love with Dae-seung, burns with jealousy toward Han-seo. His heart, sickened by unfulfilled love, drives him to make a vile and desperate choice…!
